1. **Dumbbell title "(undefined)": confirmed, P2.** Proven from the source: `targetLabel` returns `` `${t.name} (${t.catalogId})` `` when `t.name !== t.catalogId`. `CATALOGUE` builds each record from `...t` plus `CATALOGUE_VALUES`, and `CATALOGUE_VALUES` supplies `catalogName` but no `catalogId`. The appbar for `v === 'catalogue'` calls `targetLabel(record)`. The observed "Dumbbell Nebula (undefined)" therefore means `name` is present and `catalogId` is undefined. Hypothesis, since `targetSample` was not supplied: those entries key the designation as `id`, and the body renders `M27` from that field. This is a label defect only. Coordinates, magnitude and size come from `CATALOGUE_VALUES` and are untouched, so it is not a scientific error.

2. **Focus lost to BODY after Next night + Enter: confirmed, P2 (accessibility).** Proven: `changeDate` calls `render()`, which replaces `#conditions-main.innerHTML`, including `browseHeader()` and its step button. Nothing restores focus afterwards. The focused node is destroyed, so `activeElement` becomes BODY. `scrollTop = 0` adds to the disorientation for keyboard and screen-reader users. There is no data impact.

3. **Weather/night not reflected in the URL or kept on refresh: confirmed, P2.** Proven: `view` and `viewed` are read from `params` only at startup. Neither `changeDate` nor the `data-view` handler writes the URL; no `history.replaceState`/`pushState` appears. On refresh, `viewed` falls back to `active.plan.night` (19–20 Oct) and `view` falls back to `night`. Only transient browse state is lost. `localStorage`, the saved plan and the draft are not written by these paths, so it is not data loss. The displayed 20–21 Oct data was consistent with the in-memory `viewed` value, so it is not a scientific error.

**Boundary:** This is static reading of the supplied snippets only. No browser was run and no `targetSample`, `browseHeader` or `night-model.js` source was seen. The field-name cause in item 1 is a hypothesis; the other mechanisms follow directly from the code shown.
